messages.text: I’m reviewing the frozen spline, closure, and learning-curve code before validation results are inspected, focusing on data separation and bootstrap uncertainty.

**ECAL-HIGHSTAT-PHYSVAL-SOURCE**, reviewed **e8c6dc1c1e46495aa46e1f630ec250120355cf77** and the performance-only addendum **d3b20a23ef9f5cf20fcc447be57e8fbaa63c82f7**. **No actionable material defect identified.**

Source assessment:

- Ranges, knots, normalization and scaling use response-fit data only. Tuning excludes closure; the 85k refit also excludes closure.
- Global closure includes zeros. Observable-only inference preserves zero signal; closure changes scale without changing CV.
- Original/spline comparators use the declared common budgets and tuning procedure.
- Learning-curve folds and subsets exclude each evaluated event. Seeds share bootstrap multiplicities and are averaged as correlated metrics.
- The addendum shares identical basis/design moments across penalties without changing the statistical procedure.

Actual non-fitting checks passed:

- Fifty weighted-quantile controls exactly matched explicit duplicated populations.
- Stage assignment gives **70k/15k/15k**.
- All LC seed means/CVs/clipping and **80 angular mean/CV summaries** match saved predictions.
- At 8k, predictions are **bit-identical across all three seeds and to the retained original model**. All 42 zeros remain.
- Assigned hashes, LC source/core/feature bindings and three Python AST parses checked.

LC widths are **32.3518, 32.1980, 32.1912, 32.2201%** at 1/2/4/8k. This supports weak, nonmonotonic dependence over that range for the frozen architecture; it does not establish an asymptotic limit for the revised model.

Limitations: LC angular summaries contain points; stored intervals are global only. Final within-role bootstrap/repeated-selection orchestration still needs its source review. No fresh-validation performance was inspected, and no fits, simulation or writes were performed.
